name: Inbi de Zankoku na Buta
source:
"On the culture festival day everyone should give a pink heart cut-out to the person they like.
You could find your soulmate!!!"

(Girl's narrative) I had a cold view of that sort of thing.
If there was someone I loved, would that be what brings us together?
Even if I loved my sensei? And he was much older? What then?

A quiet girl named Shiho becomes close with her 52-year-old teacher. 

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE106714.html]English DLsite[/url]]
translation:
「校園祭當天，應該把粉色愛心剪紙送給喜歡的人。這樣就能找到靈魂伴侶！！！」

（女孩視角）我冷眼看待這類事情。若我愛上某個人，這就能讓我們走到一起嗎？即使我愛上老師，而他比我大很多，也一樣嗎？

安靜的女孩志保與52歲的老師逐漸親近。
